Back to overview Project 01 · Tourism Technology

Tarreef

تَريَّف

Making tourism more engaging and connected.

Tourism Technology Concept · Prototype stage Founder & Idea Owner Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Problem

A trip is made of moments — but too often they stay disconnected. Visitors move from place to place while the experience itself remains scattered: hard to follow, easy to forget. The challenge was finding what ties a whole journey together.

Idea

What if the entire visit felt like one continuous story? Tarreef approaches tourism as a connected experience — a single engaging thread that carries the visitor through the journey, instead of leaving them to piece it together alone.

Solution

The concept: an experience layer that travels with the visitor — connecting the moments of a trip into one continuous flow of discovery, and keeping the experience engaging from arrival to departure.

Key Features
01
Engagement by design

Every part of the journey is designed to invite participation — not just observation.

02
A connected journey

Places, moments, and stories are linked into one experience instead of separate stops.

03
Grounded in research

The concept was shaped by problem research into how people actually experience a destination.

Back to overview Project 02 · Health Technology

Smart Heat Shield

درع الحرارة الذكية

A smart response to heat in Hajj and Umrah environments.

Health Technology Concept · Prototype stage
Problem

Extreme heat is one of the most serious challenges facing pilgrims during Hajj and Umrah. It affects comfort and safety, and can stand between a pilgrim and completing the rituals with ease.

Idea

The project explores how technology can act as a shield between pilgrims and extreme heat — turning prevention and awareness into a natural part of the journey itself.

Solution

Smart Heat Shield is a concept for a smart protective solution — designed to reduce heat-related risks and support a safer, more comfortable experience for pilgrims.

Key Features
01
Prevention first

Designed around reducing heat-related risks before they affect the pilgrim.

02
A smart layer of awareness

The concept keeps the pilgrim aware of heat conditions as a natural part of the journey.

03
Built for Hajj & Umrah environments

Shaped by problem research into the real challenges of heat in pilgrimage settings.
